# DigitalOcean

Use `digitalocean/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "digitalocean-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "digitalocean/all-mini-lm-l6-v2",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai-compatible`

This provider uses the OpenAI-compatible adapter.

## Default base URL

`https://inference.do-ai.run/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `DIGITALOCEAN_BASE_URL`.

## Provider docs

- https://docs.digitalocean.com/products/gradient-ai-platform/details/models/
